answer.rationale: Write path latency spiked 5x within 2 hours of a release during peak settlement traffic. memory_b1 demonstrates that rollback is a reliable, low-risk intervention that cleared a similar checkout error spike without customer impact. memory_b6 confirms staged release gating catches regressions early. The timing correlation (latency climb post-release) and confined region strongly suggest the release introduced the regression. Rollback preserves all writes, avoids the complexity of failover during peak settlement load, and can execute faster than capacity provisioning or circuit breaking. We verify memory_b1 to confirm rollback safety and speed in production conditions. This is the highest-confidence path to restore the write path without data loss.
